preconditions.description: L and R are within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The length of the output sequence should not exceed 10^6 elements.
The output sequence should contain at least one element.
The output sequence should contain at most 10^6 elements.

invariants.description: The starting index L is less than or equal to the ending index R.
All elements in the output sequence are non-negative integers.
All counts in the output sequence are positive integers.

invariants.expression: sum(c_i for c_i in output_sequence) == m
invariants.description: The sum of counts in the output sequence equals the total number of elements in the sequence.

invariants.expression: output_sequence[i] != output_sequence[i+1] for i in range(len(output_sequence) - 1)
invariants.description: No two consecutive elements in the output sequence are the same.
